H5000.def: from «04998» or «05116»; suitable, or beautiful:--becometh, comely, seemly.

H5001.def: a primitive root; properly, to whisper, i.e. (by implication) to utter as a oracle:--say.

H5003.def: a primitive root; to commit adultery; figuratively, to apostatize:--adulterer(-ess), commit(-ing) adultery, woman that breaketh wedlock.

H5006.def: a primitive root; to scorn; or (Ecclesiastes 12:5) by interchange for «05132», to bloom:--abhor, (give occasion to) blaspheme, contemn, despise, flourish, × great, provoke.

H5010.def: a primitive root; to reject:--abhor, make void.

H5011.def: the same as «05108»; fruit; Nob, a place in Palestine:--Nob.

H5012.def: a primitive root; to prophesy, i.e. speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse):--prophesy(-ing), make self a prophet.

H5014.def: a primitive root; to pierce; to be hollow, or (figuratively) foolish:--hollow, vain.

H5015.def: probably of foreign derivation; Nebo, the name of a Babylonian deity, also of a mountain in Moab, and of a place in Palestine:--Nebo.

H5018.def: of foreign origin; Nebuzaradan, a Babylonian general:--Nebuzaradan.

H5019.def: or Nbukadneotstsar (2 Kings 24:1, «010») {neb-oo-kad-nets-tsar'}; or Nbuwkadnetstsar (Esther 2:6; Daniel 1:18) {neb-oo-kad-nets-tsar'}; or Nbuwkadreotstsar {neb-oo-kad-rets-tsar'}; or Nbuwkadreltstsowr (Ezra 2:1; Jeremiah 49:28) {neb-oo-kad-rets-tsore'}; or foreign derivation; Nebukadnetstsar (or -retstsar, or -retstsor), king of Babylon:--Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadrezzar.

H5021.def: of foreign derivation; Nebushazban, Nebuchadnezzar's chief eunuch:--Nebushazban.

H5022.def: feminine plural from the same as «05011»; fruits; Naboth, an Israelite:--Naboth.

H5024.def: a primitive root; to bark (as a dog):--bark.

H5025.def: from «05024»; a bark; Nobach, the name of an Israelite, and of a place East of the Jordan:--Nobah.

H5026.def: of foreign origin; Nibchaz, a deity of the Avites:--Nibhaz.

H5027.pos:
1. to look, regard
    1. (Piel) to look
    2. (Hiphil)
      1. to look
      2. to regard, show regard to, pay attention to, consider
      3. to look upon, regard, show regard to
H5027.def: a primitive root; to scan, i.e. look intently at; by implication, to regard with pleasure, favor or care:--(cause to) behold, consider, look (down), regard, have respect, see.

H5028.def: from «05027»; regard; Nebat, the father of Jeroboam I:--Nebat.

H5030.def: from «05012»; a prophet or (generally) inspired man:--prophecy, that prophesy, prophet.

H5031.def: feminine of «05030»; a prophetess or (generally) inspired woman; by implication, a poetess; by association a prophet's wife:--prophetess.

H5032.def: or Nbayoth {neb-aw-yoth'}; feminine plural from «05107»; fruitfulnesses; Nebajoth, a son of Ismael, and the country settled by him:--Nebaioth, Nebajoth.

H5033.et: from an unused root meaning to burst forth
H5033.def: from an unused root meaning to burst forth; a fountain:--spring.

H5034.def: a primitive root; to wilt; generally, to fall away, fail, faint; figuratively, to be foolish or (morally) wicked; causatively, to despise, disgrace:--disgrace, dishounour, lightly esteem, fade (away, - ing), fall (down, -ling, off), do foolishly, come to nought, × surely, make vile, wither.

H5035.def: or nebel {nay'-bel}; from «05034»; a skin-bag for liquids (from collapsing when empty); hence, a vase (as similar in shape when full); also a lyre (as having a body of like form):--bottle, pitcher, psaltery, vessel, viol.

H5036.def: from «05034»; stupid; wicked (especially impious):-- fool(-ish, -ish man, -ish woman), vile person.

H5037.def: the same as «05036»; dolt; Nabal, an Israelite:--Nabal.

H5038.def: from «05034»; a flabby thing, i.e. a carcase or carrion (human or bestial, often collectively); figuratively, an idol:-- (dead) body, (dead) carcase, dead of itself, which died, (beast) that (which) dieth of itself.

H5039.def: feminine of «05036»; foolishness, i.e. (morally) wickedness; concretely, a crime; by extension, punishment:--folly, vile, villany.

H5040.def: from «05036»; properly, disgrace, i.e. the (female) pudenda:--lewdness.

H5041.def: apparently from «05036» and «03909»; foolish secrecy; Neballat, a place in Palestine:--Neballat.

H5042.def: a primitive root; to gush forth; figuratively, to utter (good or bad words); specifically, to emit (a foul odor):--belch out, flowing, pour out, send forth, utter (abundantly).

H5043.et: from an unused root meaning to shine
H5043.def: (Aramaic) from an unused root meaning to shine; a light; plural (collectively) a chandelier:--candlestick.

H5044.def: of uncertain derivation; Nibshan, a place in Palestine:--Nibshan.

H5045.et: from an unused root meaning to be parched
H5045.def: from an unused root meaning to be parched; the south (from its drought); specifically, the Negeb or southern district of Judah, occasionally, Egypt (as south to Palestine):--south (country, side, -ward).

H5046.def: a primitive root; properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise:--bewray, × certainly, certify, declare(-ing), denounce, expound, × fully, messenger, plainly, profess, rehearse, report, shew (forth), speak, × surely, tell, utter.

H5047.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05046»; to flow (through the idea of clearing the way):--issue.

H5048.def: from «05046»; a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before:--about, (over) against, × aloof, × far (off), × from, over, presence, × other side, sight, × to view.

H5050.def: a primitive root; to glitter; causatively, to illuminate:--(en-)lighten, (cause to) shine.

H5051.def: from «05050»; brilliancy (literally or figuratively):--bright(-ness), light, (clear) shining.

H5052.def: the same as «05051»; Nogah, a son of David:--Nogah.

H5055.def: a primitive root; to but with the horns; figuratively, to war against:--gore, push (down, -ing).

H5056.def: from «05055»; butting, i.e. vicious:--used (wont) to push.

H5057.def: or nagid {naw-gheed'}; from «05046»; a commander (as occupying the front), civil, military or religious; generally (abstractly, plural), honorable themes:--captain, chief, excellent thing, (chief) governor, leader, noble, prince, (chief) ruler.

H5058.def: or ngiynath (Psa. 61:title) {neg-ee-nath'}; from «05059»; properly, instrumental music; by implication, a stringed instrument; by extension, a poem set to music; specifically, an epigram:--stringed instrument, musick, Neginoth (plural), song.

H5059.def: a primitive root; properly, to thrum, i.e. beat a tune with the fingers; expec. to play on a stringed instrument; hence (generally), to make music:--player on instruments, sing to the stringed instruments, melody, ministrel, play(-er, -ing).

H5060.def: a primitive root; properly, to touch, i.e. lay the hand upon (for any purpose; euphem., to lie with a woman); by implication, to reach (figuratively, to arrive, acquire); violently, to strike (punish, defeat, destroy, etc.):--beat, (X be able to) bring (down), cast, come (nigh), draw near (nigh), get up, happen, join, near, plague, reach (up), smite, strike, touch.

H5061.def: from «05060»; a blow (figuratively, infliction); also (by implication) a spot (concretely, a leprous person or dress):--plague, sore, stricken, stripe, stroke, wound.

H5062.def: a primitive root; to push, gore, defeat, stub (the toe), inflict (a disease):--beat, dash, hurt, plague, slay, smite (down), strike, stumble, × surely, put to the worse.

H5063.def: from «05062»; a trip (of the foot); figuratively, an infliction (of disease):--plague, stumbling.

H5064.def: a primitive root; to flow; figuratively, to stretch out; causatively, to pour out or down; figuratively, to deliver over:--fall, flow away, pour down (out), run, shed, spilt, trickle down.

H5065.def: a primitive root; to drive (an animal, a workman, a debtor, an army); by implication, to tax, harass, tyrannize:--distress, driver, exact(-or), oppress(-or), × raiser of taxes, taskmaster.

H5066.def: a primitive root; to be or come (causatively, bring) near (for any purpose); euphemistically, to lie with a woman; as an enemy, to attack; relig. to worship; causatively, to present; figuratively, to adduce an argument; by reversal, to stand back:--(make to) approach (nigh), bring (forth, hither, near), (cause to) come (hither, near, nigh), give place, go hard (up), (be, draw, go) near (nigh), offer, overtake, present, put, stand.

H5067.et: from (05110) in the sense of piling up
H5067.def: from «05110» in the sense of piling up; a mound, i.e. wave:--heap.

H5068.def: a primitive root; to impel; hence, to volunteer (as a soldier), to present spontaneously:--offer freely, be (give, make, offer self) willing(-ly).

H5069.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05068»; be (or give) liberal(-ly):--(be minded of...own) freewill (offering), offer freely (willingly).

H5070.def: from «05068»; liberal; Nadab, the name of four Israelites:--Nadab.

H5071.def: from «05068»; properly (abstractly) spontaneity, or (adjectively) spontaneous; also (concretely) a spontaneous or (by inference, in plural) abundant gift:--free(-will) offering, freely, plentiful, voluntary(-ily, offering), willing(-ly), offering).

H5072.def: from «05068» and «03050»; largess of Jah; Nedabjah, an Israelite:--Nedabiah.

H5073.et: from a root meaning to stick
H5073.def: (Aramaic) from a root meaning to stick; a layer (of building materials):--row.

H5074.def: a primitive root; properly, to wave to and fro (rarely to flap up and down); figuratively, to rove, flee, or (causatively) to drive away:--chase (away), × could not, depart, flee (X apace, away), (re-)move, thrust away, wander (abroad, -er, -ing).

H5076.def: passive participle of «05074»; properly, tossed; abstractly, a rolling (on the bed):--tossing to and fro.

H5077.def: or nada (2 Kings 17:21) {naw-daw'}; a primitive root; properly, to toss; figuratively, to exclude, i.e. banish, postpone, prohibit:--cast out, drive, put far away.

H5078.et: from (05077) in the sense of freely flinging money
H5078.def: from «05077» in the sense of freely flinging money; a bounty (for prostitution):--gifts.

H5079.def: from «05074»; properly, rejection; by implication, impurity, especially personal (menstruation) or moral (idolatry, incest):--X far, filthiness, × flowers, menstruous (woman), put apart, × removed (woman), separation, set apart, unclean(-ness, thing, with filthiness).

H5080.def: a primitive root; to push off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.):--banish, bring, cast down (out), chase, compel, draw away, drive (away, out, quite), fetch a stroke, force, go away, outcast, thrust away (out), withdraw.

H5081.def: from «05068»; properly, voluntary, i.e. generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant):--free, liberal (things), noble, prince, willing ((hearted)).

H5082.def: feminine of «05081»; properly, nobility, i.e. reputation:--soul.

H5083.et: probably from an unused root meaning to give
H5083.def: probably from an unused root meaning to give; a present (for prostitution):--gift.

H5084.def: of uncertain derivation; a sheath (of a sword):--sheath.

H5085.def: (Aramaic) from the same as «05084»; a sheath; figuratively, the body (as the receptacle of the soul):--body.

H5086.def: a primitive root; to shove asunder, i.e. disperse:--drive (away, to and fro), thrust down, shaken, tossed to and fro.

H5087.def: a primitive root; to promise (pos., to do or give something to God):--(make a) vow.

H5088.def: or neder {nay'-der}; from «05087»; a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised:--vow((-ed)).

H5089.et: from an unused root meaning to lament
H5089.def: from an unused root meaning to lament; lamentation:--wailing.

H5090.def: a primitive root; to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead, carry away; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh:--acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead (away, forth).

H5091.def: a primitive root; to groan, i.e. bewail; hence (through the idea of crying aloud), to assemble (as if on proclamation):-- lament, wail.

H5094.def: (Aramaic) or nehiyruw (Aramaic) {neh-hee-roo'}; from the same as «05105»; illumination, i.e. (figuratively) wisdom:--light.

H5095.def: a primitive root; properly, to run with a sparkle, i.e. flow; hence (transitively), to conduct, and (by inference) to protect, sustain:--carry, feed, guide, lead (gently, on).

H5096.def: or Nahalol {nah-hal-ole'}; the same as «05097»; Nahalal or Nahalol, a place in Palestine:--Nahalal, Nahallal, Nahalol.

H5098.def: a primitive root; to growl:--mourn, roar(-ing).
